caption:
Skip the designer curtains. Splurge on length. The quiet luxury window rule that makes ceilings look higher.

Mount the rod close to the ceiling and let the panels run past the frame on both sides. The hem should just touch the floor. The window reads taller, the room follows, and the fabric can stay plain.

Save this for the curtain aisle.
